subject: MAP: Load test scheduling & capacity sizing (FinTechCo)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@fintechco.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Load test scheduling & capacity sizing (FinTechCo)

Hi Carlos & Aisha,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — great discussion on the production traffic profile and your objectives for the rollout. Attached is the draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and our proposed performance test plan for the load test milestone. High level summary and asks below so we can lock the test window and sizing: 

- Goal: Replay representative production traffic to validate latency and autoscaling under peak QPS and 2x stress.
- Proposed milestones (MAP excerpt):
  1) Traffic capture & delivery (owner: FinTechCo) — deliver 30 days of anonymized traffic capture + schema.
  2) Redwood to prepare traffic-replay script and staging endpoints (owner: Redwood).
  3) Pilot load run (lower QPS) to verify setup (owner: Redwood/FinTechCo).
  4) Full load run (target: peak QPS, and optional 2x peak stress) (owner: Redwood).
  5) Post-test analysis & sizing recommendations (owner: Redwood).

Responsibilities we expect from each side:
- FinTechCo: provide captured traffic in the attached format, test credentials for staging endpoints, and a preferred 3-hour window for the run.
- Redwood: spin up dedicated capacity for the window, run the replay (optionally at 2x peak), collect metrics, and deliver a results deck and recommended dedicated pool sizing.

Attachments: FinTechCo-MAP-draft-v1.docx (MAP draft), perf_test_plan_v1.pdf (test plan + data format).

Next steps: Can you confirm the peak QPS you want tested, and two possible 3-hour windows within the next two weeks? Once we have that we will confirm capacity sizing and send a DocuSign for the small dedicated capacity addendum if you want reserved pool sizing.

Thanks — I’ve looped in Vivek for sizing and Rishi for commercial terms.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachments: FinTechCo-MAP-draft-v1.docx, perf_test_plan_v1.pdf

From: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@fintechco.com>

Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.p@fintechco.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Load test scheduling & capacity sizing (FinTechCo)

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Peak QPS: our observed peak is ~1200 QPS (per-second requests) during highest traffic hour. We’d like the test to run at 2x peak (so ~2400 QPS) to validate headroom.
- Dataset: we can provide a 30-day capture; replay script should support preserving inter-request timing. Payload sizes vary — average 1.2 KB, 95th percentile 4.8 KB.
- Proposed windows: Apr 6 08:00–11:00 PT or Apr 7 02:00–05:00 PT. Prefer Apr 6 if possible.

Questions:
1) Will Redwood need us to sign any addendum to reserve dedicated capacity for the window?
2) What artifacts do you need from our infra team (format, sample files)?

Subject: Re: MAP: Load test scheduling & capacity sizing (FinTechCo)

Hi Carlos — thanks for the details, that helps a lot. We can absolutely run the replay at 2x peak (~2400 QPS) for the full run.

What we need from FinTechCo to proceed:
- Traffic capture in the attached perf_test_plan_v1 format (gzipped HTTP traces or parquet)
- TLS test credentials and staging endpoint whitelist IPs
- Confirmation of Apr 6 08:00–11:00 PT as the preferred window (please confirm by end of day Friday)

On the addendum: if you want Redwood to reserve a dedicated capacity pool for the run (to guarantee throughput and avoid cross-tenant interference), we’ll issue a short addendum (covers reserved GPUs for the test window and a small qualified fee). If you’re comfortable with best-effort shared pool we can run without the addendum but recommend reserve for critical workloads. I’ve included a ballpark sizing and cost estimate below (final will follow after we validate the replay characteristics):

- Ballpark sizing: For 2400 QPS (mixed payloads, avg payload ~1.2 KB) we estimate needing an equivalent of 8x A100-class GPUs in a dedicated pool for the 3-hour window. If you prefer H100-class, 6x should be sufficient but availability may vary.
- Estimated test-only cost (reserved pool for 3 hours + run ops): ~$6k–$9k (finalized after we confirm exact instance types and duration).

Vivek — can you review the sizing assumptions and confirm we can spin this up Apr 6 if FinTechCo signs off? Rishi — can you flag any commercial questions re: addendum if they choose reserved capacity.

Best,
Marissa

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@fintechco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Load test scheduling & capacity sizing (FinTechCo)

Hi Carlos — looping in from the infra side. Thanks for the traffic details — that makes sizing straightforward. A few technical confirmations and asks: 

- Target test profile: 2x peak (~2400 QPS) sustained during the 3-hour window. We will run an initial pilot at 25% scale for 30 minutes to validate setup, then ramp to full.
- Sizing recommendation: for mixed payload sizes (avg 1.2 KB, p95 4.8 KB) and typical Redwood model KV cache behavior we recommend either:
  * Dedicated pool: 8 x A100-equivalent GPUs (best balance of availability and throughput), or
  * Performance pool: 6 x H100-equivalent GPUs if you require lower latency per-token and H100s are available in your preferred region.
- Operational notes:
  * Provide replay dataset as gzipped JSON lines or parquet with timestamps and unique request ids.
  * Include a small sample (1k requests) and schema so we can validate parser before the pilot.
  * Provide staging credentials (TLS cert + API key) and whitelist Redwood staging IPs (I can share the block).

We will: provision the dedicated pool at T-2 hours, run the pilot, then run the full replay at agreed time; collect token-level latency, error rates, GPU utilization, and autoscaling decision logs. Post run we will deliver a results deck with recommended Dedicated pool sizing and a follow-up plan for canary rollout.

I’ve attached a minimal perf_test_config.yml stub that outlines the replay format we expect and the metrics we will capture. Once FinTechCo confirms the Apr 6 window and shares the sample dataset we will lock the capacity and send the short addendum for reserved capacity (if selected).

-Vivek
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
